index	inspections_key	inspections	CREATE INDEX inspections_key ON inspections(idea_id, question, view, target)
index	jobs_run	jobs	CREATE INDEX jobs_run ON jobs(run_id)
index	lessons_status	lessons	CREATE INDEX lessons_status ON lessons(status)
index	notes_idea	notes	CREATE INDEX notes_idea ON notes(idea_id)
index	plantings_seed	plantings	CREATE INDEX plantings_seed ON plantings(seed_id)
index	runs_card_hash	runs	CREATE INDEX runs_card_hash ON runs(idea_id, card_hash)
index	runs_idea	runs	CREATE INDEX runs_idea ON runs(idea_id)
index	runs_status	runs	CREATE INDEX runs_status ON runs(status)
index	runs_tree_hash	runs	CREATE INDEX runs_tree_hash ON runs(tree_hash)
index	tasks_idea	tasks	CREATE INDEX tasks_idea ON tasks(idea_id, status)
index	tasks_seed	tasks	CREATE INDEX tasks_seed ON tasks(seed_id, status)
table	decisions	decisions	CREATE TABLE "decisions" ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, subject_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (subject_type IN ('run', 'idea', 'lesson')), subject_id TEXT NOT NULL, question TEXT NOT NULL, options_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', choice TEXT, decided_by TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL , payload_json TEXT)
table	events	events	CREATE TABLE events ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, ts TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, subject TEXT, payload_json TEXT )
table	ideas	ideas	CREATE TABLE ideas ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, hypothesis TEXT NOT NULL, metric TEXT NOT NULL, parent_id INTEGER REFERENCES ideas(id), confidence TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'guess' CHECK (confidence IN ('guess', 'prelim', 'confirmed', 'rejected')), status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open', 'merged', 'dropped')), branch TEXT NOT NULL, worktree_path TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, closed_at TEXT )
table	inspections	inspections	CREATE TABLE inspections ( task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(id), idea_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ideas(id), question TEXT NOT NULL, view TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (view IN ('code', 'pseudo', 'simple', 'map')), target TEXT NOT NULL, code_ref TEXT NOT NULL, tree TEXT NOT NULL, result_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL )
table	jobs	jobs	CREATE TABLE jobs ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES runs(id), segment INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (segment >= 1), job_name TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'submitting' CHECK (state IN ('submitting', 'pending', 'running', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'timeout', 'unknown')), elapsed_s INTEGER, billed_su REAL, submitted_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE (run_id, segment) )
table	lessons	lessons	CREATE TABLE lessons ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, text TEXT NOT NULL, source_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none' CHECK (source_type IN ('idea', 'run', 'none')), source_id TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'proposed' CHECK (status IN ('proposed', 'accepted', 'retired')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, decided_at TEXT, CHECK ((source_type = 'none') = (source_id IS NULL)) )
table	notes	notes	CREATE TABLE notes ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, idea_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ideas(id), run_id TEXT REFERENCES runs(id), text TEXT NOT NULL, confidence TEXT CHECK (confidence IS NULL OR confidence IN ('guess', 'prelim', 'confirmed', 'rejected')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL , author TEXT)
table	plantings	plantings	CREATE TABLE plantings ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, seed_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES seeds(id), repo TEXT NOT NULL, project_id TEXT, idea TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL )
table	runs	runs	CREATE TABLE "runs" ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, idea_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES ideas(id), snapshot_commit TEXT NOT NULL, tree_hash TEXT NOT NULL, config_json TEXT, change_reason TEXT NOT NULL, machine TEXT, "partition" TEXT, gpus INTEGER, walltime TEXT, est_cost REAL, actual_cost REAL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'awaiting_approval', 'approved', 'queued', 'running', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'rejected')), review_json TEXT, wandb_url TEXT, summary TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, request_json TEXT, card_hash TEXT , parent_run TEXT REFERENCES runs(id))
table	seeds	seeds	CREATE TABLE seeds ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, gist TEXT, hypothesis TEXT, metric TEXT, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'thinking' CHECK (status IN ('thinking', 'planted', 'dropped')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL )
table	tasks	tasks	CREATE TABLE "tasks" ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, idea_id INTEGER REFERENCES ideas(id), seed_id INTEGER REFERENCES seeds(id), text TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open', 'done', 'dropped')), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, done_at TEXT, result TEXT, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'plain' CHECK (kind IN ('plain', 'command_new', 'command_revise', 'inspect')), payload_json TEXT, CHECK ((status = 'open') = (done_at IS NULL)), CHECK ((idea_id IS NULL) != (seed_id IS NULL)) )
